src: tool descriptions: view, render_preview, inspect, search_assets, preflight_design (lumen_agent/tools)
text: Look at real pixels. target="preview" returns the latest rendered PNG; target="asset:<asset_id>" returns that asset's source preview thumbnail … so you can judge by looking, not by guessing from metadata. Optional frame_index for a GIF original.

src: tool descriptions: view, render_preview, inspect, search_assets, preflight_design (lumen_agent/tools)
text: Render the current scene to a validated PNG (and canonical SVG) … Seeing the pixels is view("preview")'s job. Requires preflight_design after any scene mutation — export refuses unresolved token paints.

src: tool descriptions: view, render_preview, inspect, search_assets, preflight_design (lumen_agent/tools)
text: Read-only inspection of the in-memory scene: scene, page, node_tree, slots, copy_review (candidate-only), geometry, slot_bindings, image_contrast.

src: tool descriptions: view, render_preview, inspect, search_assets, preflight_design (lumen_agent/tools)
text: image_contrast measures an opaque text color over actual image pixels … Excludes overlaid plates, glyphs, opacity and effects; inspect the final composition too.

src: tool descriptions: view, render_preview, inspect, search_assets, preflight_design (lumen_agent/tools)
text: Use it to confirm a node/page/slot id before targeting a repair. Never mutates.

src: tool descriptions: view, render_preview, inspect, search_assets, preflight_design (lumen_agent/tools)
text: Search all frozen workspace images by type, usage, source, text or exact id … Use view('asset:<id>') for pixels … then asset(action='use_brand_asset', asset_id=…) to place the chosen image.
note: Says place a searched workspace image with use_brand_asset; the asset tool says use_brand_asset is for Brand Kit assets and `place` is for library assets. Contradiction. Confirmed in code: use_brand_asset refuses any id not in the Brand Kit manifest (tools/substrate.py:1481).

src: tool descriptions: view, render_preview, inspect, search_assets, preflight_design (lumen_agent/tools)
text: Run canonical brand/token/layout preflight using the effective Brand Kit (the document's attached kit — or the platform default).
